## RCA (Phase 1 exit — proven root cause + runtime proof)

**Mechanism (confirmed at runtime).** `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` decides what to act on entirely from its per-component path manifests (`BOT_PATHS`, `SECRETS_PATHS`, `MCP_PATHS`, `CONFIG_PATHS`, `EDGE_PATHS`, `OBS_PATHS`, `CERTBOT_PATHS`) via `changed() { git -C "$MIRROR_DIR" diff --name-only "$DEPLOYED" "$TARGET" -- $1 | grep -q . }` (autodeploy.sh:710–711). The host-nginx include materializers and their seed — `infra/scripts/materialize-opcert-guard.sh`, `infra/scripts/materialize-mcp-upstream.sh`, the `infra/nginx/mcp-upstream.conf` seed, and the orchestrator `infra/scripts/compose-up.sh` — appear in **no** manifest, and `autodeploy.sh` never invokes `compose-up.sh` (only comment references at :148/:176). So when only a materializer source changes, every `changed` check is false, no block fires, and the loop reaches `deploy complete` — with **no `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR`**. Exact same silent-drift class as the nginx edge (1d1b) one layer up.

**Runtime proof (dynamic — real entry point, not static read).** Drove the real `autodeploy.sh` under a PATH shim where `git diff $DEPLOYED..$TARGET` reports **only** `infra/scripts/materialize-opcert-guard.sh` changed (BOT/SECRETS/MCP/CONFIG/EDGE/OBS/CERTBOT diffs empty; `flock`/`timeout`/`docker`/`curl`/`rsync` stubbed, mirroring `tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_signals_nginx_edge.py`). Result:
- `rc=0`
- stdout: `deploy complete: env now reflects <target>`
- stderr: **empty** — `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR emitted: False`

i.e. the merged materializer change reaches `/opt/rebar` and silently never applies, with zero signal. Reproduced.

**Legitimacy = defect (incomplete-implementation of a cited invariant).** Story 8903 (`gall-plume-adder`) contract is "the running environment **reflects `main`** without manual deploy or restart". A materializer-source change that reflects nowhere and signals nothing violates that invariant. Not a feature/intended-behaviour.

**Caller/blast-radius.** Fix is confined to `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` (one new manifest var + one detect-only `if changed` block) plus a new `tests/scripts/` test. No caller depends on the *absence* of the signal; `observability.sh` already counts every `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR {` into `deploy_errors` regardless of reason, so the new reason is picked up with no observability change.

**Defect origin (attribution).** Scope-of-work **omission** → story **8903-efb2-b73f-4e22** (`gall-plume-adder`, "Continuous auto-deploy: running environment reflects main"), the story that introduced the path-manifest deploy model and whose reflect-main AC this missing case falls under. This is an omission (no introducing commit broke it — the case was never written), so attribution is **by scope-of-work, not by introducing commit**, and is recorded via the **ungated `--caused-by=8903-efb2-b73f-4e22` flag on the close** (NOT a forced `caused_by` link) — the same path 1d1b used for the identical class. Close class: `plan_defect`.

**Scope — detect-and-signal ONLY.** Per ADR 0079 (v1 auto-apply scoped to the review-bot; host-nginx is detect-only) and epic 6d60 (owns auto-apply/reload), the fix adds a `MATERIALIZER_PATHS` manifest + a detect-only block emitting `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR reason=nginx_materializer_manual`, mirroring the just-merged `EDGE_PATHS`/`nginx_edge_manual` block exactly. No `nginx -s reload`/`nginx -t`/render/apply/rollback — that is epic 6d60, out of scope.
